overview.aboutNote: Prices are updated separately; a missing lot is shown as “no lot”, a missing stat as “no data”. All numbers are recomputed with one formula from the database.
overview.emptyDescription: Load the catalog with npm run sync, then add gear through the site, the API or MCP.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Appearance, sources, data, journal and cleanup
settings.appearanceText: The accent changes selection, active sections, focus and primary buttons. Positive, negative and warning colours do not change.
settings.emptyDescription: Run migrations to create source records.
settings.exportText: JSON in the source dossier format: character, gear, catalog, cards, builds and recommendations.
settings.backupsBefore: SQLite lives in a single file. A backup is taken with
settings.backupsAfter: without stopping the server; copies are kept for 14 days. Recovery is described in the RUNBOOK on a database copy.
settings.accessBefore: The site is password-protected: the session lives in an HttpOnly cookie, and changes are accepted only from this domain. The password is set in
settings.accessAfter: for local development. Secrets are not stored in the repository.

cleanup.intro: Remove dossier data from the interface. Every action is written to the change log and can be rolled back there.
cleanup.inventoryText: Every item you own, including container fills, in all categories.
cleanup.allText: Inventory and builds in one action. The catalog, prices, sources and the journal stay.
cleanup.confirmInventory: Delete all {records} inventory records ({copies} copies)? The action is written to the journal and can be rolled back.
cleanup.confirmBuilds: Delete all {count} builds? The action is written to the journal and can be rolled back.
cleanup.confirmAll: Delete all {records} inventory records ({copies} copies) and {count} builds? The action is one journal entry and can be rolled back in one step.
cleanup.journalHint: You can undo this in the Journal tab.

setup.title: Set up the dossier
setup.intro: Create the character this dossier belongs to. Gear and statistics come later.
setup.catalogIntro: The item catalog is public game data downloaded from EXBO, stalzone.wiki and the auction. It needs internet.

setup.profileIntro: The official STALZONE API fills public statistics: time in game, kills, shots fired, achievements.
setup.profileNotConfigured: The profile API is not configured. You can add statistics in the character editor later.
